title: The Popular Superstitions, Legends, and Fictions, of the Middle Ages
text: A WORK of great utility might be compiled upon the origin of popular fictions, and the transformation of similar tales from age to age, and from country to country. The Mythology of one period would then appear to pass into the romance of the next century, and that into the nursery-tale of subsequent ages.
